question: Using only the governed Fiction Retail inventory and Northeast forecast datasets, identify products whose forecast demand exceeds on-hand inventory. Return the product_id, on_hand_units, forecast_units, and recommended_reorder_quantity. Include the SQL and a chart.
answer: Analytics Agent executed the governed SQL query and returned 3 Northeast reorder candidates: SKU-DG-101, SKU-DG-102, SKU-DG-103.
sql: SELECT i.product_id, i.on_hand_units, f.forecast_units, f.forecast_units - i.on_hand_units AS recommended_reorder_quantity FROM inventory AS i JOIN northeast_forecast AS f ON i.product_id = f.product_id AND i.region = f.region WHERE i.region = 'Northeast' AND f.forecast_units > i.on_hand_units
